name: Terminal Plugin
description: xterm.js PTY terminal emulator embedded in a plugin card body. Connects to node-pty via IPC (create/write/resize/kill). Noir-themed Terminal instance with space-mono-adjacent font (Cascadia Code, Fira Code, monospace). Clipboard paste (Ctrl+Shift+V, context menu + IPC clipboard:readText). ResizeObserver + FitAddon for responsive terminal sizing. Keyboard event handling for special keys. Process exit detection via terminal:exit event listener. BASE_FONT_SIZE 13 for consistent rendering.

interface.constructor: new TerminalPlugin(container: HTMLElement, uuid: string, cwd?: string)

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Kill PTY, unlisten events, disconnect ResizeObserver, remove DOM

lifecycle.creation: TerminalPlugin is constructed → IPC terminal:create spawns node-pty shell (platform-aware: cmd.exe / zsh / bash)
lifecycle.data_flow: PTY onData → IPC terminal:data → xterm.write() → renderer Terminal widget
lifecycle.input_flow: xterm onData → IPC terminal:write → PTY stdin
lifecycle.exit: PTY onExit → IPC terminal:exit → onExit callback → card removed from canvas
lifecycle.cleanup: destroy() → kill PTY, unlisten IPC events, disconnect ResizeObserver
